headline: Accepted March minutes while library reviews FY2026 budget transfers and faces FY2027 budget cuts
summary: The Library Trustees approved the March 24, 2026 meeting minutes and heard reports on the FY2026 and FY2027 budgets, state aid plans, building repairs, and community programs. The library director said FY2027 funding may fall below required levels, possibly requiring reduced hours, and discussed using state aid for operating costs. No other votes were taken.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the March 24, 2026 meeting, 8-0
